unit.why: A short saying of R. Yaakov Yosef is followed by R. Zusya's first-person memorate: while travelling he prayed at one spot in the Zholkva study house and found his prayer unusually pure, then learned it had been the Toldot's place.
unit.boundary_note: Opening saying ('נקל לו לומר עשרה חילוקים') is a teaching without narrative; the text contains an editorial artifact 'check if sic'.

stories.start_quote: ושמעתי מר׳ זוסי' מ אנפאלי כשנסע
stories.summary_en: R. Zusya, travelling from his brother R. Elimelech through Zholkva, prayed at a spot in the study house with prayer as pure as the Besht's, and was told it had been the place of the author of Toldot Yaakov Yosef.
